content:
**Shining Creek Cavern** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

The location consists of several interconnected caves and caverns, as well as two entrances to the Vault 63 Organics Sector. Certain parts of the area only become accessible during the quest The Powerhouse of the Cell.

After entering, a small path leads into a two-story tall cavern with two Radscorpions. The lower level has one small tunnel leading northeast to a locked gate that requires the quest-related Cave Gate Key. The upper level has another locked gate on the eastern side, as well as a small tunnel leading down towards the entrance to the Vault 63 Organics Sector, which has a terminal, a locked sliding door and several Radroaches.

The locked gate on the lower level leads into a room with two Wendigos and up a ramp. The locked gate on the upper level leads into a room with three Cave Crickets and a trailer.

A ramp opposite the trailer leads up a dead Scientist next to a Pickaxe. On the wall's northwestern side is the ramp leading up from the room with the Wendigos. To the east, a large cavern opens up, with a Deathclaw emerging from the ground. This are has minor loot in several containers, as well as a note. A hatch in the corner grants access to the Vault 63 Organics Sector.

Shining Creek Cavern appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.
